WHERE P.VISIBILITY = 'PUBLIC' AND P.PUBLISH_STATUS = 'PUBLISHED' AND P.PLAN_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND M.MEMBER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
AND ( LOWER(P.TITLE) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(R.REGION_NAME) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRAVEL_PLAN P JOIN REGION_MASTER R ON R.REGION_CODE = P.REGION_CODE JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = P.OWNER_MEMBER_ID

SELECT PLAN_ID, TITLE, REGION, DAYS, LIKE_COUNT, VIEW_COUNT, AUTHOR_NAME, AUTHOR_IMAGE, THUMBNAIL_IMAGE FROM ( SELECT a.*, ROWNUM AS RN FROM ( SELECT P.PLAN_ID AS PLAN_ID, P.TITLE AS TITLE, R.REGION_NAME AS REGION, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PLAN_DAY D WHERE D.PLAN_ID = P.PLAN_ID) AS DAYS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PLAN_LIKE L WHERE L.PLAN_ID = P.PLAN_ID) AS LIKE_COUNT, P.VIEW_COUNT AS VIEW_COUNT, M.NICKNAME AS AUTHOR_NAME, M.PROFILE_IMAGE_URL AS AUTHOR_IMAGE, P.THUMBNAIL_IMG AS THUMBNAIL_IMAGE FROM TRAVEL_PLAN P JOIN REGION_MASTER R ON R.REGION_CODE = P.REGION_CODE JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = P.OWNER_MEMBER_ID
ORDER BY P.VIEW_COUNT DESC, P.UPDATED_AT DESC, P.PLAN_ID DESC ) a WHERE ROWNUM <= (#{page} * #{size}) ) WHERE RN > (#{page} - 1) * #{size}

SELECT P.PLAN_ID AS PLAN_ID, P.TITLE AS TITLE, M.NICKNAME AS AUTHOR_NAME, P.START_DATE AS START_DATE, P.END_DATE AS END_DATE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PLAN_LIKE L WHERE L.PLAN_ID = P.PLAN_ID) AS LIKE_COUNT, P.VIEW_COUNT AS VIEW_COUNT FROM TRAVEL_PLAN P JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = P.OWNER_MEMBER_ID WHERE P.PLAN_ID = #{planId}
AND P.VISIBILITY = 'PUBLIC' AND P.PUBLISH_STATUS = 'PUBLISHED' AND P.PLAN_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND M.MEMBER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update:
UPDATE TRAVEL_PLAN SET VIEW_COUNT = VIEW_COUNT + 1 WHERE PLAN_ID = #{planId}
AND VISIBILITY = 'PUBLIC' AND PUBLISH_STATUS = 'PUBLISHED' AND PLAN_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT DAY_NO AS DAY_NUMBER, TRAVEL_DATE AS VISIT_DATE FROM PLAN_DAY WHERE PLAN_ID = #{planId} ORDER BY DAY_NO ASC

SELECT D.DAY_NO AS DAY_NUMBER, I.TIME_SLOT AS TIME_SLOT, I.PLACE_NAME_SNAPSHOT AS PLACE_NAME, I.DESCRIPTION_SNAPSHOT AS DESCRIPTION, I.LATITUDE_SNAPSHOT AS LATITUDE, I.LONGITUDE_SNAPSHOT AS LONGITUDE FROM PLAN_SCHEDULE_ITEM I JOIN PLAN_DAY D ON D.PLAN_DAY_ID = I.PLAN_DAY_ID WHERE D.PLAN_ID = #{planId} ORDER BY D.DAY_NO ASC, CASE I.TIME_SLOT WHEN 'MORNING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, I.POSITION_NO ASC

SELECT P.OWNER_MEMBER_ID AS OWNER_MEMBER_ID, P.REGION_CODE AS REGION_CODE FROM TRAVEL_PLAN P JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = P.OWNER_MEMBER_ID WHERE P.PLAN_ID = #{planId} AND P.VISIBILITY = 'PUBLIC' AND P.PUBLISH_STATUS = 'PUBLISHED' AND P.PLAN_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND M.MEMBER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'

INSERT INTO TRAVEL_PLAN ( PLAN_ID, SOURCE_PLAN_ID, OWNER_MEMBER_ID, TITLE, REGION_CODE, START_DATE, END_DATE, VISIBILITY, PUBLISH_STATUS, PLAN_STATUS ) VALUES ( #{planId}, #{sourcePlanId}, #{memberId}, #{title}, #{regionCode}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, 'PRIVATE',
'DRAFT', 'ACTIVE' )
INSERT INTO PLAN_MEMBER ( PLAN_ID, MEMBER_ID, PARTICIPANT_TYPE ) VALUES ( #{planId}, #{memberId}, 'CREATOR' )
INSERT INTO PLAN_DAY ( PLAN_DAY_ID, PLAN_ID, DAY_NO, TRAVEL_DATE ) VALUES ( #{planDayId}, #{planId}, #{dayNo}, #{travelDate} )
mapper.select: SELECT D.DAY_NO AS DAY_NUMBER, I.TIME_SLOT AS TIME_SLOT, I.POSITION_NO AS POSITION_NO, I.PLACE_PROVIDER AS PLACE_PROVIDER, I.EXTERNAL_PLACE_ID AS EXTERNAL_PLACE_ID, I.PLACE_NAME_SNAPSHOT AS PLACE_NAME, I.CATEGORY_SNAPSHOT AS CATEGORY_NAME, I.ADDRESS_SNAPSHOT AS ADDRESS, I.LATITUDE_SNAPSHOT AS LATITUDE, I.LONGITUDE_SNAPSHOT AS LONGITUDE, I.IMAGE_URL_SNAPSHOT AS IMAGE_URL, I.DESCRIPTION_SNAPSHOT AS DESCRIPTION FROM PLAN_SCHEDULE_ITEM I JOIN PLAN_DAY D ON D.PLAN_DAY_ID = I.PLAN_DAY_ID WHERE D.PLAN_ID = #{planId} ORDER BY D.DAY_NO ASC, CASE I.TIME_SLOT WHEN 'MORNING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, I.POSITION_NO ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PLAN_SCHEDULE_ITEM ( SCHEDULE_ITEM_ID, PLAN_DAY_ID, TIME_SLOT, POSITION_NO, PLACE_PROVIDER, EXTERNAL_PLACE_ID, PLACE_NAME_SNAPSHOT, CATEGORY_SNAPSHOT, ADDRESS_SNAPSHOT, LATITUDE_SNAPSHOT, LONGITUDE_SNAPSHOT, IMAGE_URL_SNAPSHOT, DESCRIPTION_SNAPSHOT ) VALUES ( #{scheduleItemId}, #{planDayId}, #{source.timeSlot}, #{source.positionNo}, #{source.placeProvider}, #{source.externalPlaceId}, #{source.placeName}, #{source.categoryName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{source.address,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{source.latitude,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{source.longitude,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{source.imageUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{source.description,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
